title.narrative: Military Stipends for Peace in Somalia

description.narrative: The Stipends Support for the Somali National Army project will support the growth and development of the Somali National Army (SNA) by disbursing monthly stipends to up to 3,000 SNA soldiers and five members of the Child Protection Unit placed within the Somalia Ministry of Defense. UNOPS will also provide field-based oversight to ensure the funds are disbursed through a punctual and transparent e-payment process that is clear of any corrupt or illegal practices. Lastly, UNOPS will ensure that the soldiers receiving stipends under the project are registered and verified and that they are compliant with the UN Human Rights Due Diligence Protocol (HRDDP).
